# Resistance PEX Benchmark: kpex vs MAGIC

Comparative analysis of parasitic resistance extraction between:
- **klayout-pex (kpex)** — KLayout-based 2.5D extraction
- **MAGIC** — VLSI layout tool extraction

Compares equivalent INPUT→OUTPUT resistance across via-chain structures
parameterised by layer count (L), plane width (W), and via count (V).


```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scienceplots  # noqa: F401
import seaborn as sns

plt.style.use(["science", "ieee", "no-latex"])
sns.set_palette("colorblind")
```

## 1. Load Data


```python
PEX_DIR = Path("dataset/resistance/pex")

TOOLS = {
    "kpex": "kpex_resistance.json",
    "magic": "magic_resistance.json",
}


def load_json(name):
    p = PEX_DIR / name
    return json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}


res_data = {t: load_json(f) for t, f in TOOLS.items()}

print("Cells per tool (resistance):")
for t, d in res_data.items():
    print(f"  {t}: {len(d)}")
```

    Cells per tool (resistance):
      kpex: 81
      magic: 81


## 2. Build Comparison DataFrame


```python
def parse_res_name(name):
    """Extract PDK and parameters from resistance GDS filename.

    Format: res_{pdk}_L{layers}_W{width}_V{vias}.gds
    """
    stem = name.replace(".gds", "")
    parts = stem.split("_")
    pdk = parts[1]
    params = {p[0]: int(p[1:]) for p in parts[2:]}
    return pdk, params["L"], params["W"], params["V"]


all_cells = set(res_data["kpex"]) & set(res_data["magic"])
print(f"Cells common to both tools: {len(all_cells)}")

rows = []
for cell in sorted(all_cells):
    pdk, layers, width, vias = parse_res_name(cell)
    for tool in TOOLS:
        entry = res_data[tool].get(cell)
        if entry is None:
            continue
        rows.append({
            "cell": cell,
            "pdk": pdk,
            "layers": layers,
            "width_um": width,
            "vias": vias,
            "tool": tool,
            "resistance_ohm": entry["resistance_ohm"],
        })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.head(10)
```

    Cells common to both tools: 81

## 3. Resistance Correlation — Tool Pairs


```python
res_pivot = df.pivot_table(
    index=["cell", "pdk", "layers", "width_um", "vias"],
    columns="tool",
    values="resistance_ohm",
).reset_index()

pdks = sorted(df["pdk"].unique())
colors = sns.color_palette("colorblind", n_colors=len(pdks))
pdk_colors = dict(zip(pdks, colors))

tool_pairs = [("kpex", "magic")]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))

t_y, t_x = "kpex", "magic"
for pdk in pdks:
    mask = res_pivot["pdk"] == pdk
    subset = res_pivot[mask]
    ax.scatter(subset[t_x], subset[t_y],
               color=pdk_colors[pdk], alpha=0.7, s=25, label=pdk)
vals = res_pivot[[t_y, t_x]].values.flatten()
lims = [0, np.nanmax(vals) * 1.05]
ax.plot(lims, lims, "k--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.5, label="y = x")
ax.set_xlim(lims)
ax.set_ylim(lims)
ax.set_xlabel(f"{t_x} (Ω)")
ax.set_ylabel(f"{t_y} (Ω)")
ax.set_title(f"{t_y} vs {t_x}")
ax.legend(fontsize=6)
ax.set_aspect("equal")

fig.suptitle("Equivalent Resistance — Tool Correlation", y=1.02)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```python
for t_a, t_b in tool_pairs:

    print()
```

## 4. Relative Error Distribution


```python
layer_vals = sorted(df["layers"].unique())
layer_colors = dict(zip(layer_vals, sns.color_palette("colorblind", n_colors=len(layer_vals))))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 4))

for row, (t_a, t_b) in enumerate(tool_pairs):
    err_col = f"err_{t_a}_vs_{t_b}"
    mask = res_pivot[[t_a, t_b]].notna().all(axis=1) & (res_pivot[t_b] > 0)
    res_pivot.loc[mask, err_col] = (
        (res_pivot.loc[mask, t_a] - res_pivot.loc[mask, t_b])
        / res_pivot.loc[mask, t_b] * 100
    )

    ax = axes[0]
    ax.hist(res_pivot[err_col].dropna(), bins=25, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5)
    ax.axvline(0, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Relative error (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.set_title(f"{t_a} vs {t_b}")

    ax = axes[1]
    data_by_pdk = [
        res_pivot.loc[res_pivot["pdk"] == pdk, err_col].dropna()
        for pdk in pdks
    ]
    bp = ax.boxplot(data_by_pdk, tick_labels=pdks, patch_artist=True)
    for patch, pdk in zip(bp["boxes"], pdks):
        patch.set_facecolor(pdk_colors[pdk])
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Relative error (%)")
    ax.set_title("by PDK")

    ax = axes[2]
    data_by_layer = [
        res_pivot.loc[res_pivot["layers"] == l, err_col].dropna()
        for l in layer_vals
    ]
    bp = ax.boxplot(data_by_layer, tick_labels=[f"L={l}" for l in layer_vals], patch_artist=True)
    for patch, l in zip(bp["boxes"], layer_vals):
        patch.set_facecolor(layer_colors[l])
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Relative error (%)")
    ax.set_title("by Layer Count")

fig.suptitle("Relative Error Distribution — kpex vs MAGIC", y=1.01)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 5. Resistance vs Parameters


```python
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 4))

width_vals = sorted(df["width_um"].unique())
via_vals = sorted(df["vias"].unique())
tool_markers = {"kpex": "o", "magic": "s"}

# Resistance vs layer count
ax = axes[0]
for tool in TOOLS:
    grp = df[df["tool"] == tool].groupby("layers")["resistance_ohm"].median()
    ax.plot(grp.index, grp.values, f"{tool_markers[tool]}-", label=tool, markersize=5)
ax.set_xlabel("Layer count")
ax.set_ylabel("Median resistance (Ω)")
ax.set_title("Resistance vs Layers")
ax.set_xticks(layer_vals)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

# Resistance vs width
ax = axes[1]
for tool in TOOLS:
    grp = df[df["tool"] == tool].groupby("width_um")["resistance_ohm"].median()
    ax.plot(grp.index, grp.values, f"{tool_markers[tool]}-", label=tool, markersize=5)
ax.set_xlabel("Plane width (µm)")
ax.set_ylabel("Median resistance (Ω)")
ax.set_title("Resistance vs Width")
ax.set_xticks(width_vals)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

# Resistance vs via count
ax = axes[2]
for tool in TOOLS:
    grp = df[df["tool"] == tool].groupby("vias")["resistance_ohm"].median()
    ax.plot(grp.index, grp.values, f"{tool_markers[tool]}-", label=tool, markersize=5)
ax.set_xlabel("Via count per layer")
ax.set_ylabel("Median resistance (Ω)")
ax.set_title("Resistance vs Via Count")
ax.set_xticks(via_vals)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

fig.suptitle("Resistance Scaling with Structure Parameters", y=1.02)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 6. Per-PDK Detailed Comparison


```python
for pdk in pdks:
    subset = res_pivot[res_pivot["pdk"] == pdk].copy()
    if subset.empty:
        continue

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))

    # Grouped bar chart: resistance by layer count and via count
    ax = axes[0]
    pdk_df = df[df["pdk"] == pdk]
    bar_data = pdk_df.pivot_table(
        index=["layers", "vias"], columns="tool", values="resistance_ohm", aggfunc="mean"
    ).reset_index()
    bar_data["label"] = bar_data.apply(lambda r: f"L{int(r['layers'])}V{int(r['vias'])}", axis=1)
    x = np.arange(len(bar_data))
    tool_list = [t for t in ["kpex", "magic"] if t in bar_data.columns]
    n_tools = len(tool_list)
    w = 0.8 / n_tools
    for i, tool in enumerate(tool_list):
        offset = (i - (n_tools - 1) / 2) * w
        ax.bar(x + offset, bar_data[tool], w, label=tool, alpha=0.8)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(bar_data["label"], rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=6)
    ax.set_ylabel("Resistance (Ω)")
    ax.set_title(f"Mean Resistance")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)

    # Relative error vs via count
    ax = axes[1]
    for t_a, t_b in tool_pairs:
        err_col = f"err_{t_a}_vs_{t_b}"
        if err_col in subset.columns:
            ax.scatter(subset["vias"], subset[err_col],
                       s=30, alpha=0.6, label=f"{t_a} vs {t_b}")
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Via count")
    ax.set_ylabel("Relative error (%)")
    ax.set_title("Error vs Via Count")
    ax.set_xticks(via_vals)
    ax.legend(fontsize=6)

    # Relative error vs width
    ax = axes[2]
    for t_a, t_b in tool_pairs:
        err_col = f"err_{t_a}_vs_{t_b}"
        if err_col in subset.columns:
            ax.scatter(subset["width_um"], subset[err_col],
                       s=30, alpha=0.6, label=f"{t_a} vs {t_b}")
    ax.axhline(0, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Plane width (µm)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Relative error (%)")
    ax.set_title("Error vs Width")
    ax.set_xticks(width_vals)
    ax.legend(fontsize=6)

    fig.suptitle(f"{pdk} — Resistance Comparison", y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## 7. Summary Statistics


```python
from scipy import stats

res_summary = df.groupby("tool")["resistance_ohm"].agg(
    ["count", "mean", "median", "std", "min", "max"]
)
res_summary.columns = ["cells", "mean (Ω)", "median (Ω)", "std (Ω)", "min (Ω)", "max (Ω)"]
print("Resistance summary per tool:")
print(res_summary.to_string())
print()

# Per-pair relative error summary and correlation
for t_a, t_b in tool_pairs:
    valid = res_pivot[[t_a, t_b]].dropna()
    valid = valid[valid[t_b] > 0]
    rel_err = (valid[t_a] - valid[t_b]) / valid[t_b] * 100
    r, p = stats.pearsonr(valid[t_a], valid[t_b])
    print(f"{t_a} vs {t_b}:")
    print(f"  Pearson r = {r:.4f} (p = {p:.2e})")
    print(f"  Relative error per PDK:")
    for pdk in pdks:
        pdk_mask = res_pivot["pdk"] == pdk
        pdk_valid = res_pivot.loc[pdk_mask, [t_a, t_b]].dropna()
        pdk_valid = pdk_valid[pdk_valid[t_b] > 0]
        if pdk_valid.empty:
            continue
        errs = (pdk_valid[t_a] - pdk_valid[t_b]) / pdk_valid[t_b] * 100
        print(f"    {pdk:>6s}: mean={errs.mean():+.1f}%  median={errs.median():+.1f}%  std={errs.std():.1f}%")
    print()
```
